claims.text: Windowed one-sided upper bound kills zeros: FormB instantiates zeroFree_of_rpow_window at δ = 1/2 (la = 3/2), C = 1, requiring only Gm(y) <= y^θ on arbitrarily large multiplicative windows [Y, Y^(3/2)] (no lower bound on Gm(y) and no all-y Chebyshev bound).

Mechanism is an elementary real-variable Laplace-derivative / Chernoff-tail localization of Landau's singularity theorem (NOT Perron contour integration and NOT Turan power sums); positivity enters via |g|+g >= 0 in landau_window_ineq and chi + chi^-1 symmetrization in poleData.

Origin of la = 3/2 and 401: VWinAt ψ 401 supplies a quadratic window [W, W^2] with exponent 401; winPairs rescales x = k*x' (k = c^(1/(2+8*eps))) with W >= max(k^3, k^400) so [kW, (kW)^(3/2)] ⊆ [W, W^2] and x^400 <= (x')^401.

Origin of eps ∈ (0, 1/52): rank-height polynomial bounds require 8.01*eps <= 0.16 (eps <= 16/801 ≈ 1/50.06) and 10*eps <= 0.20, alongside Scale.eps_lt < 1/52 and Kappa4Loglog / ThickFrame2Large bounds.

nodes.summary: Applies landau_tails and landau_window_ineq + landau_coeff to prove ||(-1)^k Φ^(k)(σ+iγ)/k!|| + Re((-1)^k Φ^(k)(σ)/k!) ≤ C*exp(ηU)/(σ-θ)^k for k ≥ U.

nodes.header: theorem landau_window_ineq {g R : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Measurable g) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → |g u| ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (2 * u)) {σ θ U V : ℝ} (hσ : 2 < σ) (hθ : θ < σ) (hU : 0 < U) (hR : IntegrableOn (fun u => R u * Real.exp (-θ * u)) (Icc U V)) (hR' : ∀ u ∈ Icc U V, 0 ≤ R u ∧ g u ≤ R u) (k : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) : ‖∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (g u : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) ^ k * cexp (-((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) * ...
nodes.summary: Core positivity step: splits |g(u)|+g(u) ≥ 0 into window [U,(1+δ)U] (bounded by 2*R(u)/(σ-θ)^k) plus tail (bounded by 2*C0*∫ u^k e^((2-σ)u)/k!).

nodes.header: theorem landau_tails {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ σ : ℝ, 2 < σ ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ U : ℝ, 1 ≤ U → ∃ k : ℕ, U ≤ k ∧ ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Icc U ((1 + δ) * U), u ^ k * Real.exp ((2 - σ) * u) / (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ C / σ ^ k
nodes.summary: Chernoff-style exponential tilt bound: chooses σ = M(2+l) and k = ceil((1+δ/2)σU) so tail integral outside [U,(1+δ)U] is ≤ C/σ^k.

nodes.header: theorem landau_dichotomy {Z : Set ℂ} (hiso : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re → ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝[≠] z, w ∉ Z) {σ θ : ℝ} (hle : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re < σ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθσ : θ < σ) {ρ₀ : ℂ} (h₀ : ρ₀ ∈ Z) (hρ₀ : θ < ρ₀.re) : (∃ D : ℝ, D ≤ σ - θ ∧ (∀ w ∈ Z, w ∉ Metric.ball (σ : ℂ) D) ∧ ∃ ρ₁ ∈ Z, σ - ρ₁.re < D) ∨ (∃ β : ℝ, (β : ℂ) ∈ Z ∧ θ < β ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, σ - β < r ∧ r ≤ σ - θ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Z, w ∈ Metric.ball (σ : ...
nodes.summary: Either disk B(σ, D) is pole-free while some pole ρ₁ has σ - Re ρ₁ < D, or there is a unique real rightmost pole β in B(σ, r).

nodes.header: theorem landau_nearest {Z : Set ℂ} (hiso : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re → ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝[≠] z, w ∉ Z) {σ D : ℝ} (hle : ∀ ρ ∈ Z, ρ.re < σ) (hD : D < σ) {ρ₁ : ℂ} (h₁ : ρ₁ ∈ Z) (hρ₁ : σ - ρ₁.re < D) : ∃ γ : ℝ, ∃ ρ ∈ Z, ∃ r : ℝ, ‖(σ : ℂ) + γ * I - ρ‖ < r ∧ r ≤ D ∧ ∀ w ∈ Z, w ∈ Metric.ball ((σ : ℂ) + γ * I) r → w = ρ
nodes.summary: Picks generic vertical coordinate γ avoiding finite perpendicular-bisector set so B(σ+iγ, r) isolates a unique nearest pole ρ at distance d < r ≤ D.

nodes.header: theorem landau_cauchy {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} {r r' : ℝ} (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball z r)) (h0 : 0 < r') (h1 : r' < r) : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖iteratedDeriv k Φ z / (k.factorial : ℂ)‖ ≤ M / r' ^ k
nodes.summary: Bounds Taylor coefficients of Φ on pole-free disk via Mathlib cauchyPowerSeries and norm_cauchyPowerSeries_le.

nodes.header: theorem landau_pole_asym {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} {z ρ c : ℂ} {r r' : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ∈ Metric.ball z r) (hne : ρ ≠ z) (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball z r \ {ρ})) (hp : ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h ρ ∧ ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[≠] ρ, Φ s = c / (s - ρ) + h s) (h0 : 0 < r') (h1 : r' < r) : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(-1) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k Φ z / (k.factorial : ℂ) - c / (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1)‖ ≤ M / r' ^ k
nodes.summary: Extracts principal part c/(z-ρ)^(k+1) of Φ^(k)(z)/k! with O(M/r'^k) remainder via landau_cauchy.

nodes.header: theorem landau_window_contra {c d e E M C : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) (hde : d < e) (heE : e ≤ E) (H : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ U₀ : ℝ, ∃ U : ℝ, U₀ ≤ U ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, U ≤ k ∧ c / d ^ k ≤ M / e ^ k + C * Real.exp (η * U) / E ^ k) : False
nodes.summary: Derives contradiction c/d^k ≤ M/e^k + C*exp(ηU)/E^k for d < e ≤ E and small η > 0 via landau_growth_contra.
